name: Teknosa Ic ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
summary: Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi engages in the retail sale of consumer electronics in Turkey. It sells its products through its retail stores; and an online store, teknosa.com. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey. Teknosa Iç ve Dis Ticaret Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Haci Ömer Sabanci Holding A.S.
